name: Cheaper competitor objection (Zylo)
task: Deal: Acme Corp, $120k ARR, enterprise. Competitor Zylo is in the deal. Buyer is the VP of Engineering. Stated objection: 'Zylo is 30% cheaper.' Deal stage: final approval, security review just started.

name: Deal near signature but stalling
task: Deal: Brightline Logistics, $85k ARR, mid-market. Verbal agreement reached three weeks ago, contract sent for signature, but the buyer (Director of Operations) has gone quiet -- two follow-up emails unanswered, no stated objection. Legal redlines were returned and accepted two weeks ago. No competitor mentioned.

name: Security team blocking sign-off
task: Deal: Ferro Health, $200k ARR, enterprise healthcare. The economic buyer (VP Clinical Ops) is bought in and ready to sign, but the security team has flagged concerns about data residency and SOC 2 scope during their review. No competitor mentioned. Deal stage: security review, 3 weeks in.

name: Champion left, new stakeholder unfamiliar with the deal
task: Deal: Northwind Retail, $60k ARR, mid-market. Our champion (Head of E-commerce), who drove the evaluation and got internal buy-in, left the company two weeks ago. The deal was verbally close to signing. Their replacement is unfamiliar with the evaluation and has asked to 're-scope the conversation from the top.' No competitor mentioned, no stated pricing objection.
